A dose for pulmonary oedema is 1 to 2 mg by intrave- nous injection, repeated 20 minutes later if necessary. Alternatively, 2 to 5 mg may be given over 30 to 60 minutes in 500 mL of a suitable infusion fluid. In the treatment of hypertension bumetanide has been given in oral doses of 0.5 to 1 mg daily, although high- er doses have been used. When very high doses of bumetanide are used careful laboratory control is essential as described under the uses for furosemide (see, p.1294; high-dose therapy).
